claims: Bolivia will face Iraq in a winner-takes-all 2026 FIFA World Cup intercontinental playoff on March 31, 2026, in Monterrey, Mexico.
Moises Paniagua scored a goal for Bolivia against Suriname.
Miguel Terceros scored a goal for Bolivia against Suriname.
The winner of the Bolivia-Iraq match earns a spot at the 2026 World Cup.
The winner of the Bolivia-Iraq match joins Group I.
The Bolivia-Iraq match is the Final of the Inter-Confederation Playoff for the 2026 FIFA World Cup.
The venue for the Bolivia-Iraq match is Estadio BBVA in Monterrey, Mexico.
Iraq enters the Bolivia-Iraq match aiming for their second World Cup appearance.
